settings.founderPlacement: Seeded uniform scatter in cohort order. No subsequent introductions.

native.build: Pre-repair Rust release, linux x86_64, optimized for the host CPU.

engines.revision: The WASM repair preserves carrier carbon during near-complete continuous digestion. All mixed basin studies here use counted chemistry.

methods.readArrays: Native census, endpoint and observation arrays, together with each arm’s counts and hashes, follow lineageOrder. Registered genomes includes all variants the engine has compiled.
methods.arms: previous108 uses the preceding archive. revised108 changes six genomes. revised116 adds two each of Rememberer, Nurse rosette, Crown rosette and Pulse swimmer. feeding116 changes only the Forager from revised116. All four arms use the same habitat and mutation rate.
methods.sources: Use the genome text from sourceRevisions keyed by the cohort SHA-256. A file reference is relative to the project root. Remove its single terminal newline before hashing or compiling.
methods.nativeCensus: Per census, values follow lineageOrder. Living and cumulative births include mutated descendants. The end ledger separates predation, energy depletion and other deaths. Max generation describes living cells. A last birth of -1 means none during observation.
methods.nativeChecks: All four counted budgets (mineral, carbon, oxygen and total usable plus dissipated energy) were checked every four simulated seconds. All retained checkpoints passed. The 12-second activity counts are cell observations. A cell can be counted repeatedly.
methods.wasm: The shipped scenario harness samples every two simulated seconds, verifies budgets and saves then restores the endpoint. Digestion, fixation, and secretion in lineageActivity count distinct observed cells. Each run records both its own engine and the conditions its scenario checks actually met.
methods.lateBirths: The final 300-second window is bounded by actual censuses. When an observation stops before 300 seconds the window starts at zero.
methods.timing: Elapsed durations and rates are simulation time except where otherwise indicated.
methods.optionalDensity: moreForagers128 is the same feeding116 genome set and habitat with 24 Foragers at launch instead of 12. It is an exploratory founder-count treatment.

directTransfers.engine: native release, ABI 24, using shipped engine sources
directTransfers.root: Descendants follow genome_parent recursively to their seeded genome.
directTransfers.twoCellTrade: Both cells have one another as their only bonded peer. The Forager has a feeding junction, both transfer balances are nonzero and add to zero.
directTransfers.nurseDelivery: A Nurse younger than 50 simulated seconds with one physical link, to another Nurse, has a positive signed transfer.
directTransfers.rimSecretion: A Crown cell shows positive active exporter emission, with rim, incoming and partners confirmed in its gene evaluator at the first observed tick.
directTransfers.pulseMotor: Bonded Pulse cell has a complete PulseMotor with positive activity.
directTransfers.peakLinks: Maximum number of simultaneous pair links by lineage.
directTransfers.observedTransfers: Peaks are native body-inspector resource units per 1/30s tick.
directTransfers.crownPeakRelease: Gross food energy per simulated second.

producerExport.setting: Counted, one founder in 0.85 light for 180 s, with its descendants. Sampled exudation per living-cell-second, in food-energy units.

mixotroph.setting: Counted, one paid, lysed donor near a 45 s Mixotroph at light 0.80. Values sampled each second for 25 s.

ligandProducer.setting: Single founder with an observed secretion. Controlled heat injury, repair, and nine further simulated seconds. In a separate lit fission culture both daughters survived, retained ATP capacity, and the first daughter reproduced.

fission.setting: Counted finite-bloom reproductive fixture. Observed every second. Gut and ATP arrays list parent then daughter. Machine counts are totals across both halves.

producerGrazerExchange.setting: Counted, opposed front mounts, identical meals, open and closed exchange ports. Both treatments form the same physical association.

fission.setting: Counted finite-bloom reproductive fixture. Observed every second. Gut and ATP arrays list parent then daughter. Machine counts are totals across both halves.

producerGrazerExchange.setting: Counted, opposed front mounts, identical meals, open and closed exchange ports. Both treatments form the same physical association.

naturalInheritance.qualification: Physical inheritance varied in free-running cells. The finite-bloom capacity split applies to that observed division.

naturalFeeding.observation: The earlier meal rule suppressed the motors with unprocessable structural cargo. The feeding116 genome checks whether the corresponding digestive enzyme is installed.

replay.otherArms: Using scripts/organelle-harness.mjs, create fresh({...configuration, seed, mutationRate:0.1, countChemistry:true}). For each lineage in lineageOrder compile the source identified by the arm, then seed(api, genome, founderCount) with no coordinates. Step 30 ticks per simulated second. To reproduce a native run use the matching native build and the same exported operations.
